name: ag-ui
description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
one_liner: A shared set of rules that lets any AI agent plug into any app's screen, so builders stop writing one-off glue code for every agent-to-app connection.
buyer: Hard to name a single buyer honestly — this is a developer protocol/standard, valuable to frontend teams integrating agents, but not something most businesses would pay for directly.
business_use_cases: A frontend agency building chat-based product UIs for several clients adopts it so every client's agent backend plugs into the same UI components instead of custom glue code each time.
A SaaS platform exposes support for it so any customer's AI agent can drive its interface without the platform writing bespoke integrations per agent vendor.

money_ideas.idea: Paid consulting to integrate it into an existing product's frontend

steal_this: Build and sell a small library of pre-built, compatible UI components (chat bubbles, approval widgets) that agencies can drop in instead of building from scratch.
